reason: This plugin is a DSH web GUI navigation/utility extension that lets users view archived sessions from a new sidebar panel and restore sessions to the workspace with one-click actions via host-side archive APIs, so its primary purpose is interface-based session recovery and management.

summaries.zh: DSH Web GUI 归档管理插件在侧边栏新增历史归档入口，列出已归档会话并支持一键将其恢复到工作区。
summaries.en: A DSH web GUI archive-management plugin that adds a sidebar panel to list archived sessions and supports one-click restore back to the workspace.

capabilities: Adds a web UI sidebar panel for archived sessions
Lists archived sessions via plugin-hosted API endpoints
Performs one-click restore (unarchive) actions that update workspace state
Auto-refreshes/polls archived session data while panel is open

reasons.code: README describes a new sidebar "history archive" entry and panel in DSH Web GUI with per-item restore actions.
README states the plugin registers /api/archive-manager/list and /api/archive-manager/unarchive on host, and client consumes them for archive management operations.
package.json includes dsh client injection/runtime patch config targeting web UI integration and lists main entry points for plugin runtime and client.
